profile.tagline: Senior React Native engineer with 4+ years shipping production mobile apps end-to-end and 6+ years total in software development.
profile.summary: Senior React Native engineer with 4+ years shipping production mobile apps end-to-end and 6+ years total in software development. Hands-on experience across 9 production apps, having independently deployed 5 to the App Store and Google Play, including high-traffic products such as the ElCoach suite, which serves over 100,000 users. Specializes in integrating AI directly into mobile products (a RAG-powered chatbot and real-time AI-assisted experiences) with strong fundamentals in TypeScript, cross-platform architecture and API integration. Leads code reviews and production sign-off for a small team and is comfortable managing several concurrent engagements.
